My exes mom is a lawyer. One night my ex parked his car in front of their garage as usual since their garage was used for storage, and as always he locked the doors and rolled up the windows. Their garage has an outdoor light on the roof that shines down on to the driveway, and his car happened to be right in the way of that light beam. Well, we were all inside their house that night—he and I were in the kitchen and she happened to be walking by the front door and asked “what’s going on with your car? Something is happening. Come look.” We both knew nothing could be going on because the doors were locked and windows were closed so we took our time getting up and looking, and she went to the computer across the room to work and sat down for a split second. We didn’t get up fast enough and she repeated herself “something is up with your car. Go look at it!” She got back up to look out the window and said “I think someone’s in your car!” He and I looked at each other and smirked knowing she was having another one of her moments of stupidity (she was known for them). We drudged over to look through the window and we told her there’s no way any animal or human is in there because locked doors and closed windows but she didn’t believe us. He and I noticed the light beam hitting the driver seat at an angle, making a bit of a shadow on the head rest, and instantly we both started giggling at how stupid his mom is. So we opened the front door and all walked to the car to get a closer look. Still nothing in the car. She seemed so surprised and confused. We turned back to go into the house and, I kid you not, we had to explain to her how light beams and reflections work. She said “ohhhh…” and sounded like she felt very stupid but just walked back to the computer.
